subject: maths
question: Two trains, 165 m and 195 m in length, are running in opposite directions. The first runs at the rate of 83 km/hr and the second at the rate of 79 km/hr. How long will they take to cross each other?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ add speeds

Total distance = 165 + 195 = 360 m

Relative speed = 83 + 79 = 162 km/h = 45 m/s

Time = 360 ÷ 45 = 8 sec

**∴ Answer = 8 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lengths = 165 m and 195 m

Speeds = 83 km/h and 79 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 165 + 195 = 360 m

⇒ Relative speed = 83 + 79 = 162 km/h

⇒ Convert speed: 162 × (5/18) = 45 m/s

⇒ Time = 360 ÷ 45 = 8 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 8 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds are added

Unit Conversion

km/h to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18

Train Crossing Rule

Total distance = sum of lengths when crossing each other
